cards.title: Today
cards.do: set your energy at the top, report each task's status, follow the day strip.
cards.rule: only what you report counts, and only fully done counts as done; time passing never marks a task done.

cards.title: Plans
cards.do: compare up to 3 drafts, set one, or ask Ava to replace it.
cards.rule: plans fill 09:00–22:00; a fixed-time task can be at any hour. Only today's plan can be set.

cards.title: Calendar
cards.do: pick a day for its plan and tasks; read day, week, month and all-time reports.
cards.rule: past days are read-only; ask Ava to change a past task.

cards.title: Goals
cards.do: create, pause, resume or complete a goal; open it for its tasks and Library.
cards.rule: a goal's area is fixed; remove or unlink its tasks before removing it.

cards.title: Tasks
cards.do: add, edit and filter by area, over the last 14 days and the next 60.
cards.rule: a task with no length gets an estimate of at least 30 min.

cards.title: Areas
cards.do: check today's tasks, the agent's notes and the area's cards; add anything from “+ Add” at the top.
cards.rule: Work, someone expects it. Project, building something with an end. Learn, getting better. Life, everything else.

cards.title: Library
cards.do: write a note or import Markdown, PDF or Word; link it to an area or goal; search it.
cards.rule: nothing goes online; Ava uses it only as a reference.

cards.title: Ava
cards.do: add, move, shorten, repeat or remove tasks; start goals; change meals or plans.
cards.rule: nothing changes until you press Confirm.

cards.title: Agents
cards.do: read their notes on area pages and in Ava.
cards.rule: the Orchestrator proposes; the area agents and Summary only advise.

cards.title: Past days
cards.do: through Ava, correct, remove, or move a task to today or later.
cards.rule: on its past day, a task's time and length never change.

cards.title: Meals
cards.do: ask Ava to change a meal for one day, or from a day on.
cards.rule: no task can overlap a meal.

cards.title: Repeats
cards.do: set daily or weekly; stop or switch it through Ava.
cards.rule: a change made from a past day applies from today on.

cards.title: Energy
cards.do: tap 1–5 at the top of Today.
